title: Natclar (S.G. Natclar S.A.C.)
description:
Peruvian occupational health services company headquartered in Lima and founded in 1999. The company provides medical and health management services for workers, particularly in high-risk industries such as mining, construction, energy, and manufacturing. Its services include occupational medical exams, workplace health surveillance, diagnostic testing, on-site medical units, and emergency care to help companies monitor employee health and comply with safety regulations. Natclar operates clinics and medical units across Peru and uses digital health systems to support preventive healthcare and workforce health management.
